report.silentText: There were no words in the recording. Check the microphone and try again — the credit was not spent.
report.micText: Allow recording in your browser settings, otherwise the speech cannot be analysed.

tips.fillers_none: No filler words — the answer sounds collected.
tips.fillers_few: A couple of fillers slipped in. Catch them next time: instead of "um" just stay silent.
tips.fillers_many: Too many fillers. Replace them with a pause — a pause sounds far more confident.
tips.pace_good: The pace is conversational and easy to follow.
tips.pace_fast: You speak fast. Slow down and finish each thought with a full stop.
tips.pace_slow: The pace is slow. Keep the thought tighter and do not stretch the words.
tips.pauses_many: There were several long pauses. When you lose the thread, continue with a concrete example.
tips.repeats_many: Words repeat. Finish the phrase instead of starting it over.
tips.short_answer: The answer is short. Add one example from your life — it carries the story.
tips.keep_going: Good take. Repeat it tomorrow to make it stick.
